objective: Run one read-only research-to-change loop iteration for an ambiguous local package change and produce a human-gated implementation recommendation without mutation.

steps.task: Gather current repo evidence, affected files, runtime boundaries, tests, docs, and unknowns for the concrete parent-copied package change question. Do not run commands or edit.
Turn evidence into an implementation contract with canonical owners, rejected weak alternatives, tests, docs, and validation obligations. Do not edit.
Decide whether the implementation contract is safe to propose to the human. Return block/proceed-with-conditions/proceed and mandatory proof. This is not an implementation lane. Do not edit.

Close this gated loop iteration by reporting the proposed change, no-go conditions, human decision question, owned files and validation plan for a later authorized mutation run, validation plan, risks, and next action after all lanes terminalize, including failed or blocked lane evidence. Return observed evidence and unresolved decisions.
